title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO. TIMED AND HONEST. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN STEADY INTERVALS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SATURDAY. SATURDAY EASY CARDIO. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN STEADY TIMED INTERVALS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SATURDAY EASY CARDIO DONE. LUNGS HONEST. LEGS AWAKE. NOW GET BACK TO THAT DESK AND EARN YOUR KEEP.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: USE A LOW STAIR. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON THE RAIL IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. DRIVE THROUGH THE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET ABOUT HIP WIDTH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. STEADY TEMPO FOR THE CLOCK. EASY CARDIO PACE. QUALITY BEATS RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: BODYWEIGHT SQUATS. TWO ROUNDS. FORTY SECONDS EACH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. STEADY TEMPO. THIS IS YOUR EASY CARDIO WORK. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY PING PONG BALL.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN BURSTS. STEADY BREATH. EASY CARDIO PACE. QUALITY BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH. HANDS SET. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES. THIS IS YOUR EASY CARDIO WORK. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A PANICKED SPIDER.

exercises.name: WALKING LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP FORWARD. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. STEADY PACE DOWN THE HALL OR OPEN FLOOR. LIGHT HAND ON A WALL IF YOU NEED IT.
exercises.speakStart: WALKING LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP FORWARD. CHEST UP. STEADY PACE. THIS IS YOUR LEG CARDIO WORK. DO NOT SHUFFLE LIKE YOU ARE LATE FOR THE BUS.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. BREATHE. CONTROL BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR CORE FINISH UNDER THE CARDIO. DO NOT FLOP LIKE A PANICKED BEETLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
